name: fishball-core
description: Fishball's core plugin: the Fishball manager, its slim app and persona, the private Skills tool, and its fishball-ui component (page, recommended tab and generic slim settings with a settings-section extension point).
//: A DSH bundle of the Fishball plugin set (R-FB-01, design §1.2, §9.1). V3 R-CORE moved the slim child, persona, private Skills tool and child-web pages here unchanged; in a hosted child the instance copies src/ and ui/ as files (copyChildCode) until I-PLACE places this package. cordis.patch.yml is empty until F-GUARDS adds the guard rows, and ./client is a placeholder until the ui packages merge into it (S6, F-GUARDS). It never depends on fishball-instance (TQ-R3, R-BND-01).
//dependencies: fishball-shared holds the modules core shares with the instance (R-ARCH-08); it is bundled, so the tarball carries it.
//peerDependencies: Host packages are resolved from the running DSH installation, as for fishball-instance. fishball-connector is a peer for the same reason as the instance's (user decision 2026-11-12): it is not published, so a plain dependency would send an install to a registry; only its ./contract export is imported, until F-LINK and F-STATUS replace it with the vendored ./mcp-schema (design §9.1). Its range is the instance's. cosmokit, dsh-app-boot and dsh-llm-pi-ai are the peers of the bundled fishball-shared modules core loads (provider-sync). '*' because engines.dsh is the real compatibility gate.
